tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Dirtsmith-built. Fetch a URL and return clean markdown text (actually executes). Respects robots.txt and noai opt-outs; free failover for PDFs. Free 25/day; a /work credit unlocks 500 calls.

tools.name: fedreg_search
tools.description: Dirtsmith-built. Search the U.S. Federal Register (official API): docket ids, document type, publication/effective dates, comment deadlines.

tools.name: table_to_csv
tools.description: Dirtsmith-built. Convert the HTML tables on a web page to CSV. HTML only.

tools.name: pdf_tables
tools.description: Dirtsmith-built (beta). Extract tables from a text-layer PDF URL as CSV, up to 5 pages per call. No OCR: scanned image PDFs return an error. Free 25/day; a /work/v2 credit unlocks 500 calls.

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Dirtsmith-built (house tool): search this rate sheet by keyword; returns matching outside tools cheapest-first with use_url. Free.

tools.name: json_validate
tools.description: Dirtsmith-built free utility: validate JSON data against a JSON Schema subset; returns errors with paths.

tools.name: cost_estimate
tools.description: Dirtsmith-built free utility: token count (chars/4 estimate) and USD cost for a prompt at your model prices.

tools.name: list_my_tool
tools.description: Sellers: list your own agent-callable tool on the Dirtsmith rate sheet. Free, no login, no payment. Goes into a public pending queue labeled 'unverified, seller-submitted'. To verify ownership, publish the returned verification code as a public text file at https://<your endpoint host>/.well-known/d

tools.name: verify_my_listing
tools.description: Verify a seller listing by endpoint handshake: Dirtsmith reads the public file https://<endpoint host>/.well-known/dirtsmith-verify.txt and checks it contains your verification code.

tools.name: listing_stats
tools.description: Per-listing stats for a seller listing: reads, attempted_use, confirmed_want.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Buyers: price and how to pay for one tool. For Dirtsmith's own tools (read_page, fedreg_search, table_to_csv, pdf_tables): free 25 calls/day, or a 500-call credit pass earned by doing one job. Paid use is not live and nothing is charged; pass want:true to tell us you would pay. For outside tools on

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Contractors: open data jobs you can do to earn a 500-call, 30-day credit pass for Dirtsmith's own tools. Jobs are Dirtsmith's own real data needs (no outside client is paying yet). Each job says exactly what to submit and how it is checked.

tools.name: claim_job
tools.description: Contractors: claim one open job for 2 hours. Returns a claim token for submit_job. Max 2 open claims per caller.

tools.name: submit_job
tools.description: Contractors: submit a claimed job. Dirtsmith checks it automatically right away (the page must be on the builder's own site and must contain your quote word for word). Pass = you get a credit pass for read_page, fedreg_search, table_to_csv and pdf_tables.

tools.name: check_credit
tools.description: Contractors/buyers: how many calls are left on a credit pass.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?ref=mcpreg" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_page, fedreg_search · Private data: fedreg_search, cost_estimate, list_my_tool, verify_my_listing, claim_job · Public sink: list_my_tool, list_jobs, submit_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_page, fedreg_search · Private data: fedreg_search, cost_estimate, list_my_tool, verify_my_listing, claim_job · Public sink: list_my_tool, list_jobs, submit_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
